PROJECT 05 / 12   ·   Hardware / Automotive design

Roadster

Building a Tesla Roadster-inspired miniature from the chassis up.

Where it stands
In progress. Chassis, drive, electrical integration and bodywork are being developed; a finished, road-tested model is not yet available.

A closer look

The miniature car itself is still in development.

THE SPARK

Why this one?

I wanted to understand what goes into a car by making a smaller one, rather than only reading about how it works. A miniature roadster is a way to experiment with mechanics, electronics and the details of vehicle design.

THE BUILD

How it works

An ongoing from-scratch hardware build inspired by the Tesla Roadster. The plan brings a miniature chassis, steering and drive mechanisms, control electronics, power delivery and custom bodywork into one physical model. It is an independent student project, not a Tesla product.

Mechanical prototyping · Electronics · Motors · Microcontrollers · Power systems · CAD (planned)

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • Miniature chassis and vehicle packaging
  • Steering, drive and power-system experiments
  • Custom Roadster-inspired exterior and hardware integration

CURRENT CHAPTER

Progress & evidence

Ongoing physical build. Prototype photographs and a working demo will be added as the hardware develops.
